seo.title: Honiara homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Honiara.

page.heading: HONIARA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: Police 999. Violence support and safe referrals: Seif Ples 132; Family Support Centre 26999.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Honiara does not publish a general walk-in homeless shelter. People escaping violence can use the SAFENET referral network, which links police, health, social welfare, legal help, counselling and the Christian Care Centre. Call before travelling because refuge locations and vacancies are controlled for safety.
page.footer: Main sources: Solomon Islands Ministry of Women Youth Children and Family Affairs, Ministry of Health, Public Solicitor's Office, Family Support Centre and SAFENET partners.

entries.title: Seif Ples 24-hour hotline
entries.description: Crisis support and referral for survivors of violence through the national SAFENET network.
entries.how_to_access: Call 132. Use Police 999 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Social Welfare Division
entries.description: Government social-welfare assessment and referral. The service is part of SAFENET and can connect people affected by violence with health, legal and protection services.
entries.address: Ministry of Health and Medical Services, Chinatown, Honiara
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting and explain the urgent need.

entries.title: Christian Care Centre
entries.description: Confidential refuge and support for women and children escaping domestic violence. The centre is part of the SAFENET referral network.
entries.how_to_access: Call 36319 or 7562749, Family Support Centre, Seif Ples 132 or Police. Do not travel to a confidential refuge without referral.

entries.title: Family Support Centre
entries.description: Free confidential counselling and case-management support for women and girls experiencing domestic or sexual violence.
entries.address: Old Oxfam Office, Tongs Building, Tandai Highway, Honiara
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit during office hours. Use Seif Ples 132 outside office hours.

entries.title: National Referral Hospital
entries.description: Main public referral hospital in Honiara. The SAFENET directory also lists hospital-based mental-health and gender-based-violence services.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the emergency department for urgent medical care.

entries.title: Integrated Mental Health Services
entries.description: Hospital-based mental-health assessment and care listed in the official SAFENET directory.
entries.how_to_access: Call the clinic or attend the National Referral Hospital in a crisis.

entries.title: Social Welfare Division
entries.description: Government welfare and case-management support, including referrals for people and families in crisis.
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting and ask for an assessment.

entries.title: Public Solicitor's Office
entries.description: Legal aid, advice and representation for people in need. Honiara legal clinics cover criminal, civil, family and land matters, with specialist sessions for people with disabilities and survivors of gender-based violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call 28406 or 22348 and book the relevant legal clinic.

entries.title: SAFENET violence response network
entries.description: Coordinated referrals between police, hospital and mental-health services, Social Welfare, Public Solicitor, Family Support Centre and Christian Care Centre.
entries.how_to_access: Start with Seif Ples 132, Family Support Centre 26999 or Police 999.

entries.title: Family Support Centre counselling
entries.description: Free confidential counselling, safety planning and case management for survivors of domestic violence.
entries.address: Old Oxfam Office, Tongs Building, Tandai Highway, Honiara
entries.how_to_access: Call or attend during office hours.

entries.title: Legal clinic for people with disabilities
entries.description: The Public Solicitor's Office holds specialist legal clinics for people with disabilities at the People With Disabilities Solomon Islands facility in Chinatown.
entries.how_to_access: Call the Public Solicitor's Office to book.
